name: smwsprites-hoppycat
title: Hoppycat
description:
A spiky enemy that will hop when the player jumps.

If the extra bit is clear, it will stay in place, waiting for the player to come close to start hopping. If the extra bit is set, it will instead walk around and occasionally turn towards the player.

The enclosed graphics are by Lmda, so make sure to credit them if used!
